title: Bell scientists experienced temporal disorientation
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Bell scientists experienced temporal disorientation, about 1940s at Bell test site, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this is what the the reports are, you know, from uh Witcowski and and Frell, uh that they experience time flowing at a different rate than people outside the laboratory.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels about what he calls Hitler's secret UFO programme, talks about a device known as the Bell, said to have been tested in the 1940s. He says that, according to reports from two writers he cites, Igor Witkowski and Joseph Farrell, the scientists working on it felt time flowing at a different rate than people outside the laboratory. If true, it would suggest the device affected time itself.
